issues.summary: Rikku's and Paine's painted portraits do not render on the Chapter 4 (Bahamut) party-prep screen; they show plain letter-monogram tiles instead, while the same assets render correctly in the pre-battle banner and in the pause screen.
issues.expected: Party Prep roster and bottom party-stat cards show each character's painted portrait, as they do for Yuna and as Rikku/Paine both do in pause and the battle-start banner.

evidence: DOM read confirming art/portraits/paine.png and art/portraits/rikku-x2.png both load and decode (832x1216) while the prep screen is open
issues.verification: reproduced twice, live, with real input
issues.suspectedCause: suspected: the Party Prep roster component keys its portrait lookup off the currently-equipped dressphere art (characters/{id}-{dressphere}/idle.png) rather than falling back to the dressphere-agnostic portraits/{name}.png used elsewhere; not traced to a file/line

issues.summary: Pressing P while the FFX-2 pause screen is already open did not close/resume it in repeated automated runs; only Escape reliably resumed.
issues.expected: Unclear from the task brief whether P is meant to resume as well as open; flagging for a human decision rather than asserting a defect.
issues.observed: screen() stayed 'pause' after a KeyP press with the pause screen open; Escape reliably resumed in the same state.
evidence: manual/automated key-press sequences recorded in the session transcript
issues.verification: reproduced in automation only; not checked by a human with a real keyboard
issues.suspectedCause: suspected: by design (PauseScreen.ts binds resume only to the cancel/Escape action; BattleScreen.ts's P-key handler only ever requests opening the pause, never closing it) rather than a live regression
